status: DRAFT pending owner approval of delta and n, and a Codex review; no judging fight may run before both

engine.rule: the runner refuses any other binary; a rebuild with a different hash needs a new specification

fixed_world: DESIGN_0G.md section 1 and astelia_cpp/s3_runner.py fixed fields (rules game, mirror, 150 s, dt 1/30, 10/30/10 army, perception false, sandboxAbilities false, controlled skills game defaults + Auto)

P1.source: S4 amended B_best (tuned on full-army head-to-head novice+regular)

P2_P3.source: S4 amended C_best (tuned on the 19-doctrine pool)

entropy.derivation: seed(endpoint, index) = int.from_bytes(sha256(root || endpoint || index as 8-byte big-endian)[:4], 'big'); orientation pairs share the seed; P2/P3 block b uses one seed for all 19 doctrines and all arms
entropy.note: drawn at drafting; never used for any fight before the recorded run

P1.claim: the resonator (P1 knobs) beats the scripted level head-to-head, for BOTH novice and regular

panel.cluster: one seed, both orientations (swapSides false/true), controlledSide 0, mean S of the two

P1.statistic: mean cluster S per level; one-sided t bounds with df n-1

verdict.SUPPORTED: lower bound at 1-0.0025 > 0 for BOTH levels (intersection-union, no further split)
verdict.REFUTED: for EITHER level, upper bound at 1-0.000417 < 0 (two refutation subtests share 0.000833)

P1.subtests_reported: novice and regular reported separately as diagnostics; never relabelled as the endpoint

P2.claim: the resonator beats plain morale by more than delta on the doctrine pool

panel.setting: s4_p23 (19 doctrines; elite skills with artyRollout null and lookahead null)
panel.block: one seed for all 19 doctrines x 2 orientations; arms paired by (doctrine, seed, orientation)

P2.statistic: per block the mean of S_resonator - S_morale over its 38 fights; one-sided t bounds over the 32 blocks, df 31

P3.claim: the resonator beats the specified push-pull baseline by more than delta on the doctrine pool

delta_survivors.source: S4 amended rule max(1, 0.25 x max pooled validation paired SD), rounded up to 0.5

n_rationale: power-rule floors from S4 (P1 49 per level, P2/P3 16 per doctrine) raised to 100 per level and 32 blocks before any judging fight, because C++ fights are cheap; owner to approve
failures: a controller failure in any fight of an endpoint makes that endpoint INDETERMINATE with reason controller_failure; no fight is dropped or replaced
descriptive_only: morale, push-pull and nearest on the P1 panel
damage difference D for every fight
group diagnostics for the resonator on 3 fixed P2/P3 blocks

development_expectation_disclosed.P1: resonator B knobs: novice +5.92, regular -8.69 in S4 validation, so P1 is expected to fail on regular
development_expectation_disclosed.P2: resonator - morale -1.09 [-1.69, -0.50]: not expected to be supported
development_expectation_disclosed.P3: resonator - push-pull +7.32 [6.91, 7.73]: expected near or above delta

outputs: astelia_cpp/s6_run/: results.json with endpoint_coverage (every endpoint evaluated or not_run with reason), raw fights, verdicts computed by code; the output directory must not exist (one-shot latch)
